Evidence:
- The delegated security inspection read all five files (645 lines) and the original diff. Full-file scans found no credential values, Authorization header values, bearer/basic values, private keys, JWTs, credential-bearing URLs, user-specific home paths or session UUIDs. Long-string candidates were document paths or descriptive test names. Bare `gho_` examples in the PRD are token prefixes, not tokens.
- `receipts.md:16,30,45`: configuration references stay within pij's portable layout; temporary test paths are generic. All five documents are outside the operational local-path checker's default scope, so its `scanText` function was also applied directly to each document: zero home-path findings. The repository-wide recipe and its tests were not run.
- `receipts.md:30-31,36-37,46,49-52`: session environment-variable names have no values; synthetic seat names, PIDs, timestamps and usage counters contain no authentication capability or private transcript.
- `receipts.md:34,41,43-44`: public account handles and the generic enterprise service host are not credentials or tenant-specific routing. Existing public association was confirmed against merged `docs/plans/228-cache-proxy-sidecar/assets/evidence/live-rows.md:19-20,48`; new timing, switching and quota telemetry was independently assessed, not accepted merely because related material was already public.
- Incremental comparisons verified the wording changes at `receipts.md:37,45` and count correction at `:20`; the other four documents remained byte-identical. Git blob comparisons matched all five files to the exact reviewed head. The final worktree is clean.

Proof limits: static public-data review only; the author's live acceptance claims were not reproduced. No builds, installs, credential/configuration/session-file reads, or production changes were performed. Local `harness boot` stopped at missing worktree dependencies; full `harness checks` was not run under the no-build review scope.

Finality is separate from this security PASS: the pre-publication `just pr-freeze 242` matched GitHub and the remote at the head above but returned NOT FINAL because `rust-test` was still running and GitHub reported BLOCKED. The other four checks had passed. This verdict does not declare the PR merge-ready.
